messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Italian → Japanese)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | Vedi | 2nd sg. imperative “see / behold” | 見よ | “see / behold” | OK | | la | Definite article (feminine singular) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | “beast” (the creature) | 獣 | “beast” | OK | | per | Preposition introducing cause “because of” | のために | “for the purpose of / because of” | OK | | cu' (cui) | Relative pronoun “which / that” | それ | “that / it” | OK | | io | 1st sg. pronoun “I” (subject) | 私が | “I (subject)” | OK | | mi (reflexive) | Reflexive pronoun marking self‑directed action | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | volsi | 1st sg. past “turned” | 変えた | “turned / changed” | OK | | aiutami | 1st sg. imperative “help me” | 助けてくれ | “help (me)” | OK | | da | Preposition “against, toward” | に対して | “against / toward” | OK | | lei | 3rd sg. feminine pronoun “her” | 彼女に | “her (to)” | OK | | famoso | Adjective “famous” | 名高い | “renowned / famous” | OK | | saggio | Noun “sage” (vocative) | 賢者よ | “sage (address)” | OK | | ch'ella (che ella) | Subordinator “for / because” introducing clause | 彼女は | “she (as for)” | OK | | mi (possessive) | 1st sg. pronoun “my” (object of trembling) | 私の | “my” | OK | | fa | 3rd sg. present “makes / causes” | 震わせる | “makes tremble” | OK | | tremar | Infinitive “to tremble” (complement of *fa*) | 震える *(covered by 震わせる)* | “to tremble” | UNNECESSARY | | le | Definite article (feminine plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | vene | Noun “veins” | 血管 | “veins” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | と | “and” | OK | | i | Definite article (masculine plural) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | polsi | Noun “pulses” | 脈 | “pulses” | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, `mi` (reflexive), `le`, `i` – Italian articles and the reflexive pronoun have no direct counterpart in Japanese and are naturally omitted. - **UNNECESSARY**: `tremar` – the meaning is expressed by the causative verb `震わせる`; a separate infinitive is not needed.
All other source words are represented in the Japanese translation with appropriate lexical items and grammatical functions, so no **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues remain.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: その獣を見よ、私が向きを変えたのはそれのためだ; - Issue: internal comma; wording not a direct resultative clause. - Corrected: 獣を見よそれが私が向きを変えた原因だ;
- Line 89: - Original: 彼女に対して助けてくれ、名高い賢者よ、 - Issue: internal commas. - Corrected: 彼女に対して助けてくれ名高い賢者よ,
- Line 90: - Original: 彼女は私の血管と脈を震わせる» - Issue: none - Corrected: 彼女は私の血管と脈を震わせる»
